scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @home-music/server" "npm run dev -w @home-music/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @home-music/shared && npm run build -w @home-music/server && npm run build -w @home-music/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @home-music/shared && npm run typecheck -w @home-music/server && npm run typecheck -w @home-music/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @home-music/server && npm run test -w @home-music/web
